name: Celestial Sins
source:
A young priest on board A sanctum ship has to intercept the various signals of penitents  to hear of their sins. Some we'll be disturbing, some may open their souls to virtue, while others will double down until their sins devour them. 

[From [url=https://bonsaipeaches.itch.io/celestial-sins]itch.io[/url]]
